boundaryGate.question: After accepted AlembicPlugin commit 773dd9563d1282ede4fc5397137e98a173186ef2, does the real BiliDili P15 host MCP vs in-process parity chain pass all final hard predicates when started from an authorized BiliDili-only rebuild/reset boundary?
boundaryGate.objectBoundary: Real BiliDili workspace/data root only for this demand; no sandbox copy. Use only authorized BiliDili-scoped runtime rebuild/reset mechanisms such as alembic_bootstrap with rebuild:true before the run. Compare host MCP alembic_rescan/project-index path against in-process path and inspect SQLite coverage/session/round state plus raw route outputs.
controllerSelfChecks: Controller accepted AlembicPlugin commit 773dd9563d1282ede4fc5397137e98a173186ef2 after reviewing target result/report, task package, prior Test blocker, commit diff, source tests, and source/dist marker proof.
Controller reran npx vitest run test/unit/HostAgentSessionLease.test.ts test/unit/RescanCoverageModuleAxis.test.ts: PASS, 2 files / 15 tests.
Controller reran npm run build:check: PASS using ../AlembicCore @ edd79d26d9d539fd52e17cf67299ccdba20b4e5a.
Controller reran npm run lint:repo-boundary, lint:core-import-boundary, lint:layer-boundary, git diff --check, and source/dist repair marker proof: PASS.
realScenarioConditions: Use the real BiliDili workspace/data root configured for this Wakeflow demand; do not run against a sandbox clone.
Before the measured parity run, perform only the authorized BiliDili-scoped rebuild/reset path, and capture before/after evidence showing it was not manual SQLite/session/round editing.
Preserve configured providers: DeepSeek for generation and local Qwen/Ollama for embeddings.
Use accepted local repository heads or accepted descendants; explicitly report Alembic, AlembicCore, AlembicPlugin, and BiliDili heads and Plugin repair markers loaded.
Run both host MCP and in-process parity paths with the same P15 predicate and collect comparable normalized diff evidence.
successMeans: SQLite integrity is ok before/after the measured run, and any rebuild/reset evidence is BiliDili-scoped and authorized.
Host MCP and in-process routes both produce non-empty target-scoped coverage rows/cells.
No aggregate/root module ids remain in persisted coverage rows or in success-looking seed/advisory output on the clean pass.
Route-visible coverageLedgerSeed/meta/full briefing agrees with persisted SQLite seed summary and does not report status inconsistent on a passing run.
No active BiliDili workflow sessions remain; host-agent-rescan/deepMining rounds are closed or explicitly terminal with no open lifecycle leak.
Normalized host-vs-in-process parity is comparable and diffEmpty=true after filtering only the agreed target-scoped predicate.
Scoped git status for Alembic, AlembicCore, AlembicPlugin, and BiliDili is clean except for expected generated evidence outside product repos.
failureMeans: SQLite corruption, wrong repo head, missing Plugin repair markers, provider drift, or wrong data root invalidates the run until corrected or reported as environment/setup blocker.
Manual SQLite writes/deletes, direct session/round file edits, sandbox-copy runs, or provider changes invalidate the run.

Any aggregate/root persisted coverage row, aggregate/root success advisory/seed output, open session/round leak, seed/persisted mismatch, status inconsistent on a supposed clean pass, or non-empty normalized parity diff blocks P15.

If a clean rebuild/reset still leaves stale aggregate/root rows, preserve evidence and classify whether the owner is Plugin live route, Alembic in-process, Core persistence/reset API, or data-root environment.
If host passes but in-process keeps aggregate/root advisor/ranking independently on clean state, block with Alembic main owner hypothesis instead of rerouting automatically.
cannotConclude: Cannot conclude P15 passed from Plugin unit tests, source diff, or source/dist marker proof.
Cannot conclude P15 passed if diffEmpty=true but aggregate/root rows, seed inconsistency, or open sessions/rounds remain.
Cannot conclude Alembic main is the owner until a clean rebuild/reset run proves an in-process-only defect independent of Plugin live route.
Cannot conclude stale persisted rows are harmless; they must be absent on a clean pass or reported with owner hypothesis.
stopConditions: Stop and report if the BiliDili root, data root, provider config, or expected repo heads cannot be confirmed.
Stop and report if SQLite integrity is not ok before the measured run after authorized rebuild/reset.
Stop and report if required evidence paths cannot be captured or if the run would require manual DB/session surgery.
Stop and return blocked if any P15 hard predicate fails after a valid run.

evidenceRequired: Command transcript or script log for the authorized BiliDili-only rebuild/reset boundary.
Loaded commit/head markers for Alembic, AlembicCore, AlembicPlugin, and BiliDili; Plugin marker must include 773dd9563d1282ede4fc5397137e98a173186ef2 or accepted descendant.
Provider evidence for DeepSeek generation and local Qwen/Ollama embeddings.
SQLite integrity output and before/after coverage_ledger/deep_mining_rounds/session summaries.
Host MCP raw response, parsed response, and full briefing including coverageLedgerSeed/noActionableHostAgentWork/coverageAdvisory fields.
In-process raw evidence and comparable persisted-state summary.

Parity diff JSON and final summary JSON with explicit booleans for target rows, aggregate/root absence, sessions/rounds closed, seed consistency, SQLite integrity, normalized diffEmpty, and repo cleanliness.
Scoped git status for involved repos.
allowedOperations: Run authorized BiliDili-scoped alembic_bootstrap rebuild:true or equivalent existing runtime full-reset/rebuild path for this demand.
Read/query BiliDili SQLite and runtime JSON/logs for evidence.
Run host MCP and in-process parity commands/scripts needed for this Test card.
Write Test evidence under the Test temp/evidence paths and return TargetResultEnvelope.
forbiddenOperations: No manual SQLite writes/deletes or direct edits to session/round files.
No sandbox copy of BiliDili for this card.
No provider changes or model swaps.
No product source edits from Test.
No push, release, version bump, demand completion/archive, G6 cleanup, or compatibility alias removal.
Do not accept P15 based on diffEmpty alone.
